rows.behavior: An Add of a path that was missing before the reply writes its full content after the user approves creating it, instead of failing on the empty file the approval created.

fix.defect: Common authorization touches an approved missing file before application, so Add then finds the path, fails with "ADD Error: File already exists", leaves an empty file, still reports the path as edited, and the CLI --apply run exits 0. Repository tags expose relative and absolute filenames, a definition or reference name, and a zero-based line or minus one for lexical references.
Unsupported language, unavailable parser or query, and empty or unreadable input yield no semantic tags; otherwise captures yield definition and reference tags from UTF-8 source.
When semantic definitions exist without references, Pygments name tokens supply reference tags at line minus one.
Python queries identify constants, classes, functions, and calls including attribute names without resolving imports or receiver types.
Repository ranking distributes weighted PageRank over same-name definition and reference edges and omits definitions from files whose full contents are shared.
Ranking weights mentioned and distinctive long identifiers by ten, chat references by fifty, common or underscore-prefixed names by one tenth, and reference counts by their square root.
Maps render parent context around definition lines without child context, line numbers, or padding, allow filename-only entries, and truncate each rendered line to 100 characters.
The default map budget is one eighth of model input capacity clamped to 1024 through 4096 tokens, or 1024 when capacity is unknown.
A positive explicit map budget enables a map when Git and the selected prompt support it, even when the model defaults would disable mapping.
Map selection uses sampled token estimates and binary search for a ranked prefix within fifteen percent of budget, including allowed over-budget results.
Without chat files, the configured multiplier expands the map budget subject to known context capacity minus 4096 tokens; the RepoMap class default multiplier is eight.
Tag cache entries are reused only for the same filename and mtime and are replaced after a miss.

Manual refresh reuses the last map, files refresh reuses file-set and budget keys, always recomputes, and auto reuses hint-sensitive keys when map processing exceeds one second, without using file mtimes in map keys.
